props.name: checkedIcon
props.description: Iconify name shown inside the thumb when checked.

props.name: description
props.description: Description text rendered below the label. Overridden by the `description` slot.

props.name: highlight
props.description: Paints a static ring matching `color`, ignoring focus state.

props.name: id
props.description: Forwarded to the underlying core control.

props.name: label
props.description: Label text rendered next to the switch. Overridden by the `label` slot.

props.name: loading
props.description: Show a loading spinner inside the thumb instead of `checkedIcon`/`uncheckedIcon`.

props.name: loadingIcon
props.description: Iconify name for the spinner. Defaults to `appConfig.ui.icons.loading`.

props.name: name
props.description: Forwarded to the underlying core control.

props.name: required
props.description: Forwarded to the underlying core control.

props.name: uncheckedIcon
props.description: Iconify name shown inside the thumb when unchecked.
